title: Throne Room
summary: Throne-room scenes reveal God’s majesty, heavenly worship, judgment, authority, and comfort for His people.
background: Isaiah, Ezekiel, Daniel, and Revelation include heavenly throne visions. These scenes lift readers above earthly turmoil to God’s rule.
teachingHelp: Teach throne-room passages with reverence, emphasizing God’s holiness, authority, worship, and sovereign control.
